head: 61282a49875aaf7b8814edfa3ca9419a1590c622
claim: A built SDK consumer can leave Claude's output budget to its CLI, pass 64000 or 16385 verbatim, and receive a rejection for invalid budgets.

steps.start: Clean committed SDK build, empty private fixture home, deterministic child; no live model.
steps: A consumer imports the built public SDK and Claude entry.
Generate a complete storyboard without an output budget; observe undefined backend request and absent child env cap even with synthetic ambient cap 7.
Generate with caller budgets 64000, 16385 and 1000000; inspect child environment for verbatim values.
Compare stable unset cache identities and separate explicit budgets.
Attempt invalid budgets and observe rejection before child launch.
steps.result: Offline consumer receives complete structured data with CLI-owned unset output budget and verbatim caller budgets; invalid values are refused. This proves budget plumbing, not live high-effort model completion.
